translations./garage/brief: Take an Ackermann chassis over the same sandy route. Sand consumes traction, while steering needs turning radius; both constraints arrive together.
translations./prediction/hint: Make a prediction. When tires slip, will the steering angle still produce the expected path?
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: Slip and steering limits will compound
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Low traction and a finite turning radius demand gentle control. Compare odometry with the actual path.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: Turning radius will be the main limit
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Begin the turn too late and RO-2 must take a wider arc. Inspect the path through the bend.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-2: Steering on sand. Starting the turn early.
translations./debrief/success_summary: Tire traction and an early turn carried RO-2 through the sand.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Find which badge was lost. Steering on sand punishes sudden input.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Safety, speed, and efficiency are scored separately from this simulation run.
